stages.gate: Finish and count a full 7x7 game!

lessons.title: Placing stones
lessons.summary: Stones sit where the lines cross, not inside the boxes.

demo.caption: Watch: Black and White take turns on the line crossings.

problems.prompt: Tap the center dot (C3) to place your first Black stone.
problems.hint: Look for the dot right in the middle of the 5x5 board.

problems.prompt: Place a Black stone right next to the White stone on a line.
problems.hint: Tap above, below, left, or right of the White stone.

problems.prompt: Corner stones sit on the edge crossings. Play next to White at A5.
problems.hint: Tap right next to the corner stone along the top or left edge.

lessons.title: Liberties
lessons.summary: Empty spots connected by a line are a stone's liberties (breathing spots).

demo.caption: Watch: each Black stone covers one of White's 4 liberties.

problems.prompt: White has 2 liberties left. Cover one of them!
problems.hint: Play right next to the White stone on an empty dot.

problems.prompt: A corner stone only has 2 liberties. Cover one of them!
problems.hint: Tap either empty crossing next to the corner stone.

problems.prompt: This edge stone has 2 liberties left. Take one away!
problems.hint: Play on one of the two empty dots touching White.

lessons.title: Capturing
lessons.summary: Cover a stone's very last liberty to capture it!

demo.caption: Watch: Black covers the last liberty and captures the White stone.

problems.prompt: Capture the White stone!
problems.hint: Find the one remaining liberty dot next to White.

problems.prompt: Capture the corner White stone!
problems.hint: Corner stones only have 2 sides. Cover the open one.

problems.prompt: Capture the edge White stone!
problems.hint: Play directly below the White stone.

lessons.title: Atari and saving
lessons.summary: One liberty left is called atari. Save your stone by running or connecting!

demo.caption: Watch: Black is in atari (red ring). Extending gives it 3 liberties!

problems.prompt: Your Black stone is in atari! Save it.
problems.hint: Play on your stone's last liberty to give the group more breathing room.

problems.prompt: Save your edge stone from being captured!
problems.hint: Extend toward the center.

problems.prompt: Save your stone by connecting it to your other Black stone!
problems.hint: Play between your two Black stones.

lessons.title: Connecting and cutting
lessons.summary: Connected stones share liberties. Cutting splits enemy stones into weak pieces.

demo.caption: Watch: Black plays between the White stones, cutting them apart.

problems.prompt: White is threatening to capture. Give your stone more liberties!
problems.hint: Extend up from your left Black stone.

problems.prompt: Cut the two White stones apart!
problems.hint: Play right between the two White stones.

problems.prompt: Connect your Black stones to save the stone in atari!
problems.hint: Play at B3 (between your two Black stones) to share liberties.

lessons.title: No suicide (unless you capture!)
lessons.summary: You cannot place a stone with zero liberties—unless it captures enemy stones first.

demo.caption: Watch: A5 looks surrounded, but playing there captures White first!

problems.prompt: Play in the corner to capture the White stones!
problems.hint: It's legal because it takes White's last liberty.

problems.prompt: That spot is surrounded by White, yet Black can play there. Why? Capture!
problems.hint: Playing at C2 captures the White stone in the middle.

lessons.title: Two eyes live
lessons.summary: A group with two separate inside spots (eyes) can never be captured.

demo.caption: Look: Black's group has two separate eyes (A5 and C5? No, A5 and B5/D5). White can't fill both!

problems.prompt: Make two separate eyes for your Black group!
problems.hint: Play in the middle to split the space into two eyes.

problems.prompt: Split the top row into two separate eyes!
problems.hint: Play at the top center (C5).

lessons.title: Real Go vs Capture Go
lessons.summary: In real Go, you win by surrounding more space—not just chasing stones.

demo.caption: Watch: build walls around corners and sides to claim territory.

problems.prompt: Extend your wall to surround the top-left corner!
problems.hint: Connect or extend near your stones in the top-left.

lessons.title: Passing, counting, and komi
lessons.summary: When both players pass, the app counts stones + surrounded empty points. White gets +7.5 komi.

demo.caption: Black has 10 points (5 stones + 5 space). White has 10 + 7.5 komi = 17.5!

problems.prompt: Both sides' territory is finished. Tap Pass to end the game and count!
problems.hint: Use the Pass button below the board.

lessons.title: False eyes
lessons.summary: An eye with enemy stones on its corners can be poked out — it is a false eye.

demo.caption: Watch: White's corner spot looks like an eye, but Black captures at A5!

problems.prompt: Break the false eye and capture White!
problems.hint: Play right inside the corner.

lessons.title: Ladders
lessons.summary: Chase an enemy stone in a zig-zag across the board until it hits the edge.

demo.caption: Watch: Black keeps White on 1 or 2 liberties, herding it toward the edge.

problems.prompt: Put White in atari toward the top edge to capture it!
problems.hint: Play to the right of the White stone.

lessons.title: Nets
lessons.summary: Surround from a step away so the enemy stone has no escape route.

demo.caption: Watch: instead of touching, Black casts a loose net around White.

problems.prompt: Close the net around the White stone!
problems.hint: Block White's escape to the right.

lessons.title: Snapbacks and throw-ins
lessons.summary: Sometimes sacrificing one stone lets you immediately capture a bigger group back.

demo.caption: Watch: Black throws in at B5, White captures at A5, and Black snaps back at B5 to capture 5 stones!

problems.prompt: Throw in to set up a snapback and capture the White group!
problems.hint: Play at B5 — if White captures at A5, you can immediately snap back at B5.

lessons.title: Ko and the ko rule
lessons.summary: You cannot immediately recapture a ko — play a threat elsewhere first.

demo.caption: Watch: White captures at B4. Black must play elsewhere before recapturing at C4.

problems.prompt: White to play: capture the Black stone in the ko!
problems.hint: Play at B4 to capture C4.

lessons.title: Corners first
lessons.summary: Corners are easiest to surround with territory (only two sides to wall off).

demo.caption: Watch: both players claim the 3rd-line / star-point corners before the center.

problems.prompt: Claim an open corner!
problems.hint: Play near one of the two open star points.

lessons.title: Extending and building a base
lessons.summary: After a corner or side stone, extend along the 3rd line to make space for two eyes.

demo.caption: Watch: a two-space extension gives your stone room to live.

problems.prompt: Extend from your C7 stone along the side!
problems.hint: Play 2 or 3 spaces along the 3rd line.

lessons.title: Opening on 13x13
lessons.summary: On 13x13, star points are on the 4th line. Balance corners, sides, and connecting fights.

demo.caption: Watch: claim star points on the 4th line, then build toward the sides.

problems.prompt: Play on one of the open 13x13 corner star points!
problems.hint: Look for the empty corner star-point dots.
